exposure: intracervical Foley catheter for induction of labor
outcome: vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) success rate
cohort: The study participants were women with singleton term pregnancy and one previous lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) who underwent induction of labor.
finding: Induction of labor with intracervical Foley catheter effectively improved the modified Bishop score and increased the chance of successful vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) in women with previous LSCS.
mod_finding: A successful vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) was achieved in 65.62% of women, with a higher success rate among those with a previous VBAC.
